movie: The SpongeBob Movie Search for SquarePants
review:
Not an avid fan of SpongeBob, but to me it felt like what an extended episode of the show would be, but this one with a different art style (I guess to have a premium movie feel?), which felt a bit weird at first but got it used to it and even liked parts later on.

Overall plot is serviceable, nothing too deep or thought provoking, but enough to keep the characters moving and the jokes coming, which mostly I found funny, but a few were repeated more than the necessary and got a bit stale fast.
